verdict.rationale: Square's Payouts API lets developers list/see payouts (square-docs-25) and dashboard messaging references managing cash flow (square-docs-23), but the evidence pack contains no documentation of instant or next-day payout options, fee/speed tradeoffs, or a way to trigger a faster payout on demand. Missing for 10: explicit instant/next-day payout feature docs, UI/API to trigger expedited payout, fee details for speeding up transfers, and independent confirmation it works as described.
